meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测蛋白质与小分子的结合构象
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是从事药物设计或结构生物学的科研人员
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a researcher in drug design or structural biology

howto.what: 安装后，Claude能用DiffDock做蛋白质-小分子对接：输入蛋白结构（PDB或序列）和配体（SMILES/SDF/MOL2），预测配体的3D结合构象，按置信度打分并排序，输出排名构象文件；也可批量对接和虚拟筛选。不预测结合亲和力。
howto.when: 当用户要求做蛋白质-小分子对接、预测结合构象或虚拟筛选时触发。

say.text: 我有这个蛋白的PDB和配体的SMILES，帮我用DiffDock对接到一起。
say.note: Claude会运行单复合物对接，返回排名构象。

say.text: 帮我批量对接这个CSV里的10个蛋白-配体对。
这些对接结果的置信度分数怎么解读？
say.note: Claude会根据分数范围解释高/中/低可靠度。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude runs DiffDock to predict 3D poses of a small-molecule ligand against a protein (from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2), ranks poses by confidence, and outputs SDF files. Supports batch docking and virtual screening. No affinity prediction.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for protein-small-molecule docking, binding-pose prediction, or virtual screening.

say_en.text: Here are a protein PDB and a ligand SMILES; dock them with DiffDock.
say_en.note: Runs single-complex docking and returns ranked poses.

say_en.text: Batch-dock the 10 protein-ligand pairs in this CSV.
How should I interpret the confidence scores of these docking results?
